schema.label: Design
schema.text: Multicenter phase III non-inferiority trial (ISRT-NPC) in stage I to III nasopharyngeal carcinoma with limited nodal burden. The methods call the trial subject-blinded; the abstract calls it open-label. Primary endpoint is 3-year regional recurrence-free survival. Target accrual is 414, allowing 5% dropout, for 85% power and a one-sided alpha of 2.5%.

schema.label: Stratify
schema.text: Institution scale (large versus small) and N stage (N0 versus N1 versus N2). Block size is 4.

schema.label: Randomize
schema.text: 1:1 computer randomization to involved-site nodal irradiation or elective regional irradiation. Primary-tumour volumes are shared. Prescription from the dose table: PGTVnx, PGTVrpn, and PGTVnd 69.96 Gy in 33 fractions of 2.12 Gy; PGTVns and PTV1 60.06 Gy in 33 fractions of 1.82 Gy; PTV2 50.96 Gy in 28 fractions of 1.82 Gy. Stage III disease also receives concurrent cisplatin 100 mg/m2 on days 1 to 3 every 3 weeks, up to three cycles.

arms.label: Involved-site irradiation
arms.text: High-risk CTV1 includes a 1 cm expansion of positive nodes, level VIIa, and the retrostyloid space above the C1 transverse process. Low-risk CTV2 covers a 3 cm caudal expansion below C1 for N0 disease, or 3 cm below the positive node for node-positive disease, at least including level II.

arms.label: Elective regional irradiation
arms.text: N0 high-risk volume includes bilateral level II, and the low-risk volume includes bilateral level III and Va. Node-positive disease treats the whole involved level plus at least one subsequent level.

brief.schema_source: Open-access protocol, Liu et al., BMC Cancer 2023 (PMID 37537541). Read from the full text.
eligibility: Age 18 to 75, KPS at least 70, WHO type II or III nasopharyngeal carcinoma, AJCC/UICC 8th edition stage I to III (T1 to 3, N0 to 2, M0).
Cervical nodes at most 3 cm and without high-grade extranodal extension. T4, N3, nodes larger than 3 cm, and high-grade extranodal extension are excluded.

Hemoglobin at least 120 g/L, white cells at least 4 x 10^9/L, platelets at least 100 x 10^9/L, and liver and kidney indices within 1.5 times the upper limit of normal. Expected survival at least 6 months.

Excluded: another malignancy except stage I non-melanoma skin cancer or in situ cervical cancer, pregnancy or lactation or no contraception, another interventional trial, and uncontrolled comorbidity.

pretreatment.item: History, examination, KPS, weight, height, vital signs, and nasopharyngeal, nodal, and neurologic exam
Blood count, biochemistry, urine and stool, lymphocyte phenotyping, and EBV DNA
Nasopharyngoscopy and biopsy, contrast MRI and CT of nasopharynx and neck, cervical ultrasound, chest CT, abdominal CT or ultrasound, and bone scan
